variety: Egyptian Arabic with English marketing terms

decisions.text: الـ launch event هيبقى يوم الخميس 17 ديسمبر.
تقسيم ميزانية الـ 600 ألف جنيه: 40% TikTok و35% influencers و25% Instagram.
الحملة هتشتغل مع اتنين influencers بس: ندى فودي وزيزو.
الـ KPI الأساسي 3 مليون view على TikTok في أول أسبوعين بعد الـ launch.

actions.what: تبعت الـ brief وتقفل العقود مع ندى فودي وزيزو
تبعت الـ content calendar النهائي على الجروب
يكلم مجدي ويعاين الـ rooftop في الزمالك ويحجزه للـ event
يبعت لسلوى ملخص الاجتماع وتقسيمة الميزانية عشان تعتمدها

open_questions.text: لو الـ engagement طلع ضعيف في أول أسبوع، نحول فلوس من TikTok لـ Instagram؟
الـ event هيبقى بالدعوات بس ولا مفتوح للجمهور؟

traps: No speaker labels at all: owners are only known from how people are addressed (e.g. line 2 'يا كريم', 44 'يا هبة', 56 'يا منى', 72 and 80 'يا عمرو', 86 'تمام يا كريم' after Karim's own task in 85).
Rejected proposal: Amr suggests a billboard on the Ring Road (18-22); it costs about half the budget (23) and Karim rejects it (24). It is not a decision to do it.
Self-correction of a day: the event is first said as Wednesday the 16th, then corrected to Thursday 17 December (12). The old idea of 'early December' (10-11) is dropped.
Self-correction of a number: the TikTok target is first 2 million views, corrected to 3 million (64, confirmed 66). Nada Foodie's 1.8 million followers (37) is not a target.
Task moved: checking and booking Magdy's rooftop venue is first given to Heba (77), then moved to Amr (79-81) because she travels; final owner Amr, due Monday.
Dates that are not deadlines: Heba's trip from 28 November to 3 December (78); Karim's other call at twelve o'clock (7, 84); the Ramadan event (76) is past.
Task with no deadline: Amr's KPI dashboard (71-73), 'مش مستعجل، على راحتك'.
Not a decision: YouTube ads 'نفكر فيها بعد الـ launch' (58-59).
Heba's contracts are due 26 November (45), which is before her 28 November trip; the deadline is the 26th, not the 28th.
